repair_application_rule: These are proposals only. A6 may apply only an explicitly approved item, record before/after state, run targeted regression, and preserve rollback evidence.

repairs.proposed_change: After human source confirmation, reconcile the attachment/source manifest and update only derived control evidence; do not promote the year without full-year evidence.
repairs.verification_after_repair: Re-hash supplied carriers, verify attachment identity, reconcile counts, and run only the affected 2015 checks.
repairs.rollback_plan: Restore the prior manifest and derived control records from the pre-repair commit; retain the source confirmation as an external review artifact.
dependencies: human confirmation of the missing attachment/source bundle

repairs.rollback_plan: Restore the prior derived records and keep the year conditional if source confirmation fails.

repairs.current_state: Twelve open blocking missing-segment requests remain; the received subset is not the full year.

repairs.rollback_plan: Remove only newly added derived records and restore the pre-repair manifest; retain the open request rows if any source cannot be verified.

repairs.current_state: 24 nodes were collected, 0 terminal outcomes were observed, and the annual run timed out at 300 seconds with exit code 124.
repairs.proposed_change: Perform node-level diagnosis and a continuation limited to 2017 only after approval; preserve the aggregate timeout record and do not rerun other years.
repairs.verification_after_repair: Use node-level execution, record the last completed node and cause, then run only the approved 2017 continuation and update evidence with terminal outcomes.
repairs.rollback_plan: Do not overwrite the existing A4 record; if continuation is inconclusive, retain the timeout aggregate and revert only new diagnostic artifacts.
dependencies: human acceptance of a 2017-only diagnostic plan

repairs.rollback_plan: Restore the conditional gate/checkpoint and explicit missing-file list if any attachment cannot be verified.

repairs.verification_after_repair: Record review coverage, external-source provenance, and targeted 2021 regression without copying raw source into the repository.
repairs.rollback_plan: Retain the conditional status and prior coverage notes if external scope cannot be established.

repairs.current_state: A3 identified annual tests that confuse global queues with year-specific queues and rely on total queue-row counts; progress.json is a partial historical status file.
repairs.proposed_change: Separate global-queue assertions from year-scoped assertions and make progress checks scope-aware; do not delete queue rows or promote missing year entries.
repairs.verification_after_repair: Run only affected annual tests, assert both global and year-specific scopes, and verify no queue or progress input changed.
repairs.rollback_plan: Revert only the targeted assertion changes and retain the A3 finding if the scope contract is not approved.
dependencies: human approval of queue/progress scope contract

repairs.current_state: A3 identified errors=ignore scans in 2017, 2018, 2019, and 2025, which can hide decode defects.
repairs.proposed_change: Replace silent decoding with an explicit evidence policy that records decode failures without changing source bytes or falsely treating unreadable text as clean.
repairs.verification_after_repair: Run affected tests and verify BOM/UTF-8 policy, error visibility, and unchanged source hashes.
repairs.rollback_plan: Revert only the decoding-policy changes if the approved contract is not met; preserve the finding and evidence.

repairs.current_state: A3 recorded 69 BOM-related findings and nonuniform page/worksheet upper-bound assertions across annual tests.
repairs.proposed_change: Define input-tolerant versus output-strict encoding behavior and use evidence-derived page/worksheet bounds without broad assertion weakening.
repairs.verification_after_repair: Run affected targeted tests, check strict output encoding, verify page/sheet evidence, and compare source hashes before and after.
repairs.rollback_plan: Revert only approved test-policy changes and retain the A3 findings when evidence is insufficient.
